shadows.name: signature-glow
shadows.purpose: Reserved exclusively for the AutomationConsole panel.

motion.name: reveal-ease

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill button, Paper fill, Ink text, bronze hover with a slight scale lift.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #f7f4ec; color: #0a0a09; padding: 14px 24px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: transform 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #b8935e; transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b8935e; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Resting content card: hairline border, faint white tint on ink.
components.html:
Workflow Automation

We map the manual steps buried in your operations and rebuild them as automations that run without supervision.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 16px; padding: 32px; } .ds-card-title { color: #f7f4ec; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 500; margin: 0 0 12px; } .ds-card-body { color: #a8a49a; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Underline-only field with an animated bronze focus rule and a visible focus-visible ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 12.5px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #a8a49a; } .ds-field-input { display: block; width: 100%; margin-top: 8px; padding-bottom: 10px; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); color: #f7f4ec; font-size: 15px; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(184,147,94,0.7); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Section Eyebrow
components.description: The system's connective-tissue label: parenthesized, uppercase, tracked, bronze.

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Circular-bordered live-status indicator used in the AutomationConsole.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #a8a49a; } .ds-pill-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(52,211,153,0.8); animation: ds-pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.4; } }

narrative.overview: Lamb Solutions lives in near-total darkness lit by a single warm signal — the color of an indicator light left on overnight while the automation keeps working. The system pairs an almost-black ink field with one restrained bronze accent and just enough editorial serif italic to prove a human, not a template generator, wrote the words. Nothing shouts. Precision reads as confidence: thin borders instead of shadows, generous negative space instead of decoration, one signature live-data widget instead of stock illustration. The aesthetic rejects both extremes an AI agency could default to — the neon-gradient 'future tech' cliché, and the flat blue-and-white SaaS-template look. Lamb Solutions is closer to a well-run night shift at a precision workshop than a Silicon Valley pitch deck: dark, controlled, warm at the edges, and quietly certain of itself.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ink field, one warm bronze accent, restrained by design
Fraunces italic as the system's single voice of emphasis, always paired against plain Geist sans
Depth from opacity layering and hairline borders, not shadows
Asymmetric grids instead of centered symmetry
Uppercase tracked labels function as the system's punctuation

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Bronze is the system's only accent. A second accent color must still read as warm and dark-compatible.

rules.name: The Single Accent Line Rule
rules.body: Fraunces italic never carries an entire heading or paragraph alone — it appears as one phrase inside a Geist-set sentence.

rules.name: The Directional Split Rule
rules.body: A section with two content types splits asymmetrically rather than stacking two equal columns.

rules.name: The Flat-Except-One Rule
rules.body: Everyday elevation is hairline-border-plus-opacity-tint; a real shadow is spent once, on the system's signature object.

dos: Do keep bronze to labels, hover states, glows, and single accent moments.
Do pair every Fraunces-italic phrase with plain Geist sans in the same sentence or heading.
Do use the uppercase tracked Label style for every eyebrow, form label, nav link, and stat caption.
Do default new sections to an asymmetric split when pairing two content types.
Do build elevation from hairline borders and opacity-tinted surfaces first.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue outside bronze and the reserved error-only rust.
Don't use a sharp or small corner radius anywhere.
Don't add a conventional drop shadow to an ordinary card or button.
Don't run motion unconditionally; every animated element must respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Don't center a two-content-type section symmetrically.
